notes.title: Farm Day 2023 is LIVE!!!
notes.content:
Hi

We are thrilled to announce that Farm Day 2023 is finally here and ready for you to download and play! We have been working tirelessly to bring you the best farming experience, and we believe this new version is the best yet.

In Farm Day 2023, you can build and manage your own farm, raise animals, and grow crops. With new features such as weather changes and seasons, you will have to adapt and plan accordingly to ensure your farm thrives throughout the year.

We have also added new characters and quests to keep you entertained and engaged. So, whether you are a seasoned farmer or new to the genre, there is something for everyone to enjoy in Farm Day 2023.

Don't wait any longer, download Farm Day 2023 now and start your farming adventure today!

notes.title: Get Ready to Harvest: Farm Day 2023 Launching in 2 Days!
notes.content:
We are thrilled to announce that the release of Farm Day 2023 is just two days away! On March 21st, we will be publishing one of our best farming games yet. Following the success of our first version in 2021, we have been hard at work to bring you a new and improved experience.

Get ready to dive into the world of farming and experience the joy of harvesting your crops, tending to your animals, and building up your farm. With new features and improvements, Farm Day 2023 promises to be even more engaging and entertaining than before.

We can't wait for you to play the game and experience all the new content we've added. Keep an eye out for the release on March 21st and let us know what you think!

Thank you for your continued support and we look forward to seeing you on the farm.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2344350/Farm_Day_2023/

Best regards,
The Farm Day team
